whatChanged.updateNote: Sample update note. This line is not a news item.
whatChanged.updateNoteZh: 示例更新说明。这一行不是新闻。
whatChanged.headline: Sample headline for the first section
intro: Placeholder paragraph one. On a wide screen this text sits to the left of the drawing.
Placeholder paragraph two. It exists so the opening has a second block of reading.
introZh: 占位段落一。宽屏时这段文字在图画的左边。
占位段落二。用来让导语有第二段可看的文字。

image.alt: Sample line drawing of a circle, a square, and an arrow
image.altZh: 示例简笔画：一个圆、一个方块和一支箭头

sections.heading: Is this a real story?
paragraphs: No. These sentences are layout filler. They do not describe an event, a company, or a number.
A second placeholder paragraph stays on the page. Nothing here is hidden behind another click.
paragraphsZh: 不是。这些句子只用来看版式，不描述任何事件、公司或数字。
第二段占位文字一直留在页面上，没有被折起来，也不需要再点开。

whatChanged.ending: A quiet sample ending. Nothing here is a conclusion about the world.
whatChanged.endingZh: 一句安静的示例收尾。这里没有关于世界的结论。

stayCurious.headline: Sample headline for the second section
intro: More placeholder text. This opening also sits beside its own drawing on a wide screen.
introZh: 更多占位文字。宽屏时这一段也排在它自己的图画旁边。

image.alt: Sample line drawing of a window and a leaf
image.altZh: 示例简笔画：一扇窗和一片叶子

sections.heading: What should this paragraph say?
paragraphs: Only that it is a stand-in. Read it to check line length, then forget it.
paragraphsZh: 只说明它是占位。用它看行宽就好，看完可以忘掉。

stayCurious.ending: Another quiet sample line, still not a real closing thought.
stayCurious.endingZh: 另一句安静的示例，仍然不是真正的收尾。

closing: Sample sign-off. Not a real farewell.
closingZh: 示例收尾，不是真正的告别。
